gloss: practitioner, master (of a trade or skill)

definitions.gloss: practitioner, master (of a trade or skill)
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a skill or activity to name someone who practices or has mastered it — a doctor, teacher, fisherman, or craftsperson. Emphasizes skill and practice more than formal licensing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漁|りょう}{師|し}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{木彫|きぼ}り→木彫り：07063_kibori⟧{師|し}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was a wood carver well known in his local area.

notes:
〜{師|し} names a person by their trade or skill: ⟦{教|きょう}{師|し}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧ (teacher), ⟦{医|い}{師|し}→医師：11851_ishi⟧ (doctor), ⟦{漁|りょう}{師|し}→漁師：21205_ryoushi⟧ (fisherman), and craft compounds like ⟦{木彫|きぼ}り→木彫り：07063_kibori⟧{師|し} (wood carver).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧: a licensed or certified professional — ⟦{弁護|べんご}{士|し}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧ (lawyer), ⟦{会計|かいけい}{士|し}→会計士：06083_kaikeishi⟧ (accountant). Carries a connotation of formal qualification that {師|し} does not require.
- 〜⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: expertise or dedication in a field — often broader or more prestigious, as in ⟦{専門|せんもん}{家|か}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (specialist).
- 〜⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: a generic "person who does," with no implication of skill or training.
